speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment of your double vision, difficulty climbing stairs, and upper limb weakness, please tell me: when did these symptoms first start, and have they been getting worse over time?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis.

The symptoms of diplopia worsening with upward/downward gaze, along with fatigable weakness that improves with rest, are classic for myasthenia gravis. I will now request specific tests to confirm this diagnosis.

REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibodies
REQUEST TEST: Repetitive_nerve_stimulation
REQUEST IMAGES: Neurological_muscle_exam
